profile.summary: My name is Aayush Patel and I am a Biological Engineering graduate from The Ohio State University I have previously worked at Kumon North America at Lewis Center as a teaching assistant working with students to help improve their math and reading skills while also having the opportunity to showcase my ability to work with a team as well as my problem solving and critical thinking skills. I have also volunteered for many different organizations like the Red Cross and Mt.Carmel St. Ann's.
